topics.name: Artificial Neural Networks
topics.description: A computational model inspired by the human brain's network of neurons.

sub_topics.name: Neuron
sub_topics.description: The basic unit of computation in an artificial neural network.

sub_topics.name: Activation Function
sub_topics.description: A mathematical function that determines the output of a neuron.

sub_topics.name: Backpropagation
sub_topics.description: An algorithm for training neural networks by minimizing error.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of linear algebra and calculus, familiarity with programming concepts.
common_misconceptions: Neural networks can learn without data
More layers always mean better performance

topics.name: Linear Algebra
topics.description: A branch of mathematics essential for understanding machine learning algorithms.

sub_topics.name: Linear Separation
sub_topics.description: The ability to separate data points using a linear boundary.

sub_topics.name: Matrix Operations
sub_topics.description: Fundamental operations involving matrices used in machine learning.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of algebra and familiarity with mathematical notation.
common_misconceptions: Linear algebra is only about solving equations
Vectors can only represent physical quantities

topics.name: Loss Functions
topics.description: Functions that measure the difference between predicted and actual outcomes.

sub_topics.name: Mean Squared Error
sub_topics.description: A common loss function used for regression tasks.

sub_topics.name: Cross-Entropy Loss
sub_topics.description: A loss function often used for classification problems.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of statistics and linear algebra.
common_misconceptions: Loss functions only apply to regression problems.
Lower loss always means better model.

topics.name: Regression
topics.description: A statistical method for predicting continuous outcomes.

sub_topics.name: Linear Regression
sub_topics.description: A technique for modeling the relationship between variables.

sub_topics.name: Polynomial Regression
sub_topics.description: An extension of linear regression that models non-linear relationships.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of statistics and algebra.
common_misconceptions: Only linear relationships can be modeled

topics.name: Classification
topics.description: The process of predicting categorical outcomes based on input data.

sub_topics.name: Binary Classification
sub_topics.description: A classification task with two possible outcomes.

sub_topics.name: Multi-Class Classification
sub_topics.description: A classification task with more than two possible outcomes.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of statistics and programming.
common_misconceptions: Classification is only for binary outcomes
More features always improve classification accuracy

topics.name: Training Techniques
topics.description: Methods used to improve the performance of machine learning models.

sub_topics.name: Gradient Descent
sub_topics.description: An optimization algorithm used to minimize loss functions.

sub_topics.name: Regularization
sub_topics.description: Techniques to prevent overfitting in machine learning models.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of machine learning concepts and algorithms.
common_misconceptions: More data always leads to better performance
Overfitting only occurs with complex models

topics.name: Exercises
topics.description: Practical tasks designed to reinforce learning concepts in machine learning.

sub_topics.name: Hands-On Coding
sub_topics.description: Exercises that involve writing code to implement algorithms.

sub_topics.name: Theoretical Problems
sub_topics.description: Exercises focused on understanding the mathematical foundations.

common_misconceptions: Practical tasks are not necessary for understanding theory

sub_topics.name: Supervised Learning

sub_topics.name: Unsupervised Learning
sub_topics.description: A type of learning where the model identifies patterns in unlabeled data.
